title: Give the check-in, exchange, intro and unlock link pages their site shell
detail:
The four lead-capture doors (a printed QR at the door, a warm intro, a share-back, a resource unlock) render FrequencyCaptureShell, the funnel stage whose .fn-* classes are styled only under the site kit root. The (capture) route group had no layout, so every door, valid token or not, was unstyled: system font, ink on a blank canvas, flush to the top-left corner. Fix: a group layout that wraps the doors in the chrome-free SiteShell, as the other funnel doors use (ADR-591). Measured after: the kit root is present, the h1 wears Unbounded, the card sits centred on the stage at 1280 and 390.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check on /intro, /checkin and /unlock: kit root present, Unbounded h1, card centred on the stage.
